body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> [CES Unveiled] ProVision Communications showcased its 'AXAR 1000 series at CES 2010.

The AXAR 1000 Sender and Receiver ensure that optimum HD video throughput and performance is sustained Across-All-Rooms (AXAR) of the home. AXAR 1000 uses standards based 802.11n Wi-Fi and H.264 AVC technology in conjunction with AXAR Media's unique intellectual property, to penetrate through multiple walls, floors and doors.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
